messages:
Nora - People Ops: Quick heads-up 14: were publishing a clarification to the Emergency Dependent Care & Travel Assistance policy today. This clarifies eligibility for school/daycare closures, sudden caregiver incapacity, and short-notice international repatriation support. Full doc: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/dependent-care-assist

Diego - People Ops: TL;DR: eligible events include sudden school/daycare closures, primary caregiver hospitalization, and government-ordered evacuations. Key benefits: up to 5 days paid Emergency Dependent Care (EDC) per incident, up to $1,000 one-time Travel Assistance for urgent family repatriation, and expedited same-day claim route. EDC is separate from PTO.

Ravi: Quick Q: for school closures, is this per child or per family?

Nora - People Ops: Great Q 14: EDC is per household incident, not per child. If multiple children are affected by the same closure, its one incident credit. If separate events occur, theyre separate incidents.

Elena: Manager flow if someone needs same-day time off because daycare closed?

Diego - People Ops: Managers can approve an "EDC - expedited" request in Workday. For immediate approvals, approve and mark as "expedite"; People Ops will follow up for minimal verification within 7 days. If employee is in transit or unreachable, do a provisional approve and notify people-ops@redwood.com.

Ravi: Are receipts required for the $1,000 travel assistance? Any tax notes?

Benefits-Bot: Travel assistance provisional payout up to $300 available without receipts for urgent needs; full claim to $1,000 requires receipts submitted within 60 days. Payouts are taxable and will appear on payroll. See FAQ in the policy doc.

Elena: How does this interact with existing Dependent Care FSA or local statutory supports?

Nora - People Ops: EDC is additive. Use Dependent Care FSA for eligible childcare expenses; EDC covers emergency leave and the travel assistance covers urgent relocation/return costs. If statutory/local benefits apply, we coordinate top-ups case-by-case. Examples in the policy doc.

Ravi: Any limitations for international employees or cross-border families?

Diego - People Ops: International staff are eligible but travel assistance caps and documentation differ by country. We have an international appendix in the doc; if you have a specific country case, DM people-ops and well handle it. For high-risk evacuations, travel-safety and Legal will be looped in.

Nora - People Ops: Were running a 20-min manager briefing tomorrow 9:15am PT to cover approvals, payroll handling, and examples. RSVP link in the policy doc. If you need an urgent case triaged today, please tag @people-ops in the channel or email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "EDC-URGENT".

Ravi: Thanks 44dThis should help support the team with last-minute school closures.

Elena: Appreciated 64fOne ask: can we add an example flow for cross-timezone adoptions or guardianship emergencies?

Diego - People Ops: Noted and adding now 4ddWell update the appendix before the manager briefing.
